name: margin
description: Your pen drawing board, for agents: read what you shared, answer beside it, and propose marks, plots and diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: Your drawing board, for Codex to read and answer on.
interface.longDescription: Margin is a pen drawing board for the iPad. With this plugin, Codex reads the drawing you shared (an overview image, a close crop of what you selected, and stroke positions), answers with short notes pinned beside it, keeps a small memory of the board's goal and decisions, and can propose marks, plots and diagrams that stay faint until you keep them.
defaultPrompt: Check my Margin board and answer my question
Look at what I circled on my board and explain it
Plot the function I wrote on my board
